title: mut.manual
mutation_directive: Crystalline lattice growth: particles snap to hexagonal grid nodes, propagate via reaction-diffusion rules, zero hand-placement — pure cellular automaton logic, cold mineral formation.

morakana.praise: The Gray-Scott parameters tuned to 'coral-like spots' carry latent ecological memory — activator/inhibitor dynamics genuinely model how territorial chemistries compete for substrate, which has political charge waiting to be activated.
morakana.concern: Felix Gonzalez-Torres is invoked on the `.src` label but not loaded into the physics. His work was about government abandonment during the AIDS crisis — that weight is named, then abandoned. The piece stays at decorative mineral formation with no conceptual stakes.
morakana.directive: Bind F (feed rate, line 65) to an external reef-bleaching or ocean-temperature index fetched at load, so the crystalline pattern's spread encodes real environmental collapse, not decoration.

tyler_hobbs.praise: The amber→rose quartz→opal age-palette (lines 207–211) is deliberately sequenced with age-gated smoothstep transitions — this is a curated palette that earns its progression, not a random HSL spin.
tyler_hobbs.concern: Single centered 3×3 seed (lines 82–91) means the RD front radiates symmetrically outward in all directions — the 44×44 grid fills toward every edge equally. There is no asymmetric composition weight, no deliberate negative space, no hierarchy. The camera tracking the centroid (line 334) barely moves, reinforcing the static, centerless composition.
tyler_hobbs.directive: Before the RD run, force 3 diagonal strips of cells to permanently `occupied=false` and `b=0` — carve fixed void corridors that the growth must route around, creating asymmetric weight.

entangled_others.praise: Using actual Gray-Scott morphogenesis physics rather than simulating biological appearance is the honest move — the same equations govern animal skin patterning, wound healing, and embryo formation. The substrate is genuinely biological.
entangled_others.concern: The 'mineral' framing actively suppresses the biology that the equations are doing. Naming the palette 'amber → rose quartz → opal' routes the piece toward the abiotic mineral kingdom when the activator-inhibitor system is more honestly a cellular or immune process — which would actually honor Gonzalez-Torres' real stakes (body, AIDS, immune failure).
entangled_others.directive: Reframe the shader palette and internal comments as cytokine gradient / cellular signal — immune-gold to scar-tissue rose to lymph-opal — so the body's morphogenesis is the explicit subject.

casey_reas.praise: The hex Laplacian applied to Gray-Scott (lines 109–118) is rigorous — local six-neighbor averaging producing globally emergent spotted form is exactly the Process Compendium mandate: deterministic local rules, surprising global behavior.
casey_reas.concern: Math.random() is called inside the per-frame particle render loop (lines 306–310) — approximately 40,000 times per frame — injecting stochastic noise at every cycle. The rule system is deterministic; the rendering betrays it completely.
casey_reas.directive: Replace all Math.random() in the render loop with deterministic functions: angle = (particleIndex * 2.399963) mod 2π (golden angle), radius = fract(sin(cellIndex * 127.1)) * HEX_R * 0.65 — zero randomness in render.

quayola.praise: OCCUPY_THRESH=0.36 (line 147) creates a genuine measurement boundary — cells with B between 0.2 and 0.36 exist fully in the simulation but are invisible in the render. That unreached data is already there; the code just discards it.
quayola.concern: Every occupied cell receives a uniform full-density particle fill; nothing renders the near-threshold zone where the model is uncertain. The growth frontier pretends completion. The grid boundary is silently clamped (lines 113–116) with no acknowledgment that the measurement failed at the edge.
quayola.directive: Add a second render pass for cells where B ∈ [0.2, 0.36]: 8% alpha, 3 particles per cell max — a ghostly uncertainty halo that makes the model's measurement frontier spatially visible.
